skill_name: Write an essay about data security.
workflow: Data security is an important and often overlooked aspect of our lives, as every day we are becoming increasingly reliant on technology for our activities. As we use more and more devices and access more web applications, our data is vulnerable to security threats, whether it be malicious hackers, unintended mistakes or inadvertent breaches of data.
